verdict.rationale: TruffleHog supports gating via verification status (--only-verified, --results=verified,unknown, --fail) which acts as a confidence-based filter to suppress unverified/noisy findings from failing builds, and detector-level include/exclude and verify overrides add further control. However, there is no explicit severity scoring system, only a verified/unverified/unknown confidence axis, so it only partially matches the 'severity or confidence' gating story.
